appliedUpdates.description: Created .factory/library/runtime-patterns.md documenting: @tool_fn marker pattern (not @dspy.tool), Daytona-bound tool stub convention, filesystem.py dual-definition pattern, AgentRuntime interpreter holding design, _LegacyAgentRuntime cleanup note, FleetAgentSignature placement inconsistency.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add rule: new @tool_fn-decorated tools that require a live Daytona interpreter must follow the stub pattern (raise RuntimeError with clear guidance message). Mention that runtime/tools/ has this convention for Daytona-bound tools.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: tool-registry feature introduced 6 stub tools (execute_code, read_buffer, write_buffer, clear_buffer, read_core_memory, write_core_memory) with no documented convention for future tool authors.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance on how legacy code is flagged before deletion: use a module docstring note AND a TODO comment with the target milestone/feature. The current pattern of only documenting in docstrings (without deprecation decorators or ticket references) may cause the legacy code to linger.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: _LegacyAgentRuntime in runtime/agent/runtime.py is flagged 'to be deleted' in the module docstring but has no deprecation decorator or milestone reference. AGENTS.md has no guidance on this pattern.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update any references to '@dspy.tool decorator' to reference the custom '@tool_fn' marker pattern from runtime/tools/_marker.py. DSPy 3.1.3 has no @dspy.tool — tools are discovered via the @tool_fn marker and wrapped as dspy.Tool instances by discover_tools().
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: tool-registry worker noted in skillFeedback.suggestedChanges: 'The skill says @dspy.tool decorator but DSPy 3.1.3 has no such decorator'. Worker correctly deviated from outdated skill text.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The rule 'Keep DSPy signatures in runtime/agent/signatures.py' should be reinforced or clarified. FleetAgentSignature was placed in agent.py by the core-react-agent-module worker because the feature description said to use RLMReActChatSignature (incompatible fields). Future feature descriptions creating new signatures should explicitly reference signatures.py as the required location.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: FleetAgentSignature is in agent.py:15 rather than signatures.py. AGENTS.md already states the rule but the worker's rationale was reasonable (the feature description contradicted it).

rejectedObservations.observation: agent-runtime: AgentRuntime holds interpreter but doesn't expose it in public API
rejectedObservations.reason: Captured in library/runtime-patterns.md. This is a design note for future workers, not a guidance update.
